SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS posts_today
FROM posts
WHERE
    (scheduled_at >= (CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw')
     AND scheduled_at < ((CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw'))
 OR (published_at >= (CURRENT_DATE AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw')
     AND published_at < ((CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Warsaw'));

SELECT id, created_at, scheduled_at
FROM posts
WHERE status = 'READY'
  AND (scheduled_at IS NULL OR scheduled_at > NOW())
ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC
LIMIT 50;
